description.text: Semester: The first semester: from the beginning of September to next late January. The second semester: from the end of February to early July.

duration.text: The Applied Chemistry at Tianjin University of Science and Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record.

requirements.text: Applicant should hold high school graduation or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate Be in good health; Non-Chinese speakers must reach a C level (Level 3) in Chinese Proficiency Test for foreigners; Have to take some entrance tests for relevant courses
